sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 740. Success value 100. 5x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 170. Prohibits Unison for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 50.
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 50.
-Target: all allies. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Savior Element (increases all stats by 120%, increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack by 6, and increases Cost recovery speed by 10) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 150 seconds.
Fire and Light Defense from Unison Damage +700
